headline: Auto-Research Arena reports multi-objective benchmark results for autonomous research systems
summary: A UC San Diego and Adobe Research paper introduces Auto-Research Arena, a benchmark spanning nine language-model efficiency objectives. In a single reported testbed, the authors compare six LLM research harnesses and a non-agentic baseline using two foundation models. No harness dominates all objectives; simple Sequential Search ranks second overall in both model groups. In a separate one-hour follow-up search, the authors report lower training loss under matched data and FLOPs and lower held-out BPB at the same model size after combining selected discoveries. These are author-reported results from one setup, not evidence of general autonomous scientific-research capability.
